title: Add JSON output to peers list
summary: Add a `--json` flag to `covenant peers list` so tooling and live tests can consume a stable machine-readable shape without parsing tab-delimited human output.
expectedFailureModes: Live tests parse `peers list` output and extract the wrong token prefix or pubkey when rendering changes.
`--json` output omits `truncated` context, causing operators to assume the result set is exhaustive.
JSON output accidentally leaks token bytes, private key material, or other redacted peer registry fields.
nextAction: Implement `covenant peers list --json`, update the live tests that currently parse human output, and document the machine output contract.
